resources.string: Configure your own SOCKS5 or HTTP CONNECT endpoint. Credentials are encrypted on this device. Assigned apps stay blocked while their proxy is disabled, missing or unregistered. HTTP CONNECT supports TCP only; DNS keeps the selected Telos resolver. Explicit app proxy choices take priority; assigned WireGuard tunnels take priority over the default proxy.
Not registered in an active VPN
Apps assigned to this proxy remain blocked after removal. Choose another endpoint or a direct route to reconnect them.
Enter credentials again when editing. Empty credentials remove proxy authentication.
